token.note: Mock USDC, 6 decimals, OPEN mint: testnet play money, not Circle USDC.

txs.step: operator publishes cert: bound 150, reserve 100, float cap 20, allowlist [service], premium 3, expires +1h
agent accepts (its full-access key, the last time it is used)
auditor attests, locking 200 of its stake behind this cert
agent adds a function-call key: receiver bound-v3.boundproto-nh26.testnet, methods ["pay"], allowance 0.25 NEAR (gas only)
agent pays service 5 through bound pay (the function-call key, no deposit)
agent pays 1 to service while halted
challenger files BoundExceeded (bond 10) while spent 5 <= bound 150
anyone tries to close the window right away
operator resumes (so the next refusal is the freeze, not the halt)
agent pays 1 while the claim window is open
service withdraws 135 to its token account
operator publishes cert 2 for agent2: bound 50, reserve 30, float cap 10, premium 1
operator funds reserve 30 (ft_transfer_call with the reserve action)

keyLevelRefusals.error: AccessKeyDepositWithFunctionCallActionError: Deposit is not allowed with function call

keyLevelRefusals.step: same key calls bound withdraw (needs 1 yocto)
keyLevelRefusals.error: AccessKeyDepositWithFunctionCallActionError: Deposit is not allowed with function call

keyLevelRefusals.step: same key sends 0.01 NEAR to the attacker
keyLevelRefusals.error: AccessKeyRequiresFullAccessActionError: Access key requires full access
